follow-up time: Variable, up to at least 65 months
outcome: Size of the lesion on clinical examination
Recurrence of abdominal wall endometriosis after surgical excision
cohort: 34 cases of abdominal wall endometriosis and 68 controls who underwent surgery for endometriosis at Mayo Clinic between 2000 and 2013.
finding: The study identified cyclic localized abdominal pain, absence of dysmenorrhea, and history of prior laparotomy as independent risk factors for abdominal wall endometriosis.
